1.web: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
1.asv: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

2.web: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
2.asv: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

3.web: The Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
3.asv: And the Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

4.web: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house; six thousand were officers and judges;
4.asv: Of these, twenty and four thousand were to oversee the work of the house of Jehovah; and six thousand were officers and judges;

5.web: four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made, for giving praise.”
5.asv: and four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised Jehovah with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.

6.web: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
6.asv: And David divided them into courses according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

7.web: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
7.asv: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

8.web: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
8.asv: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

9.web: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
9.asv: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’housesof Ladan.

10.web: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
10.asv: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

11.web: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
11.asv: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

12.web: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
12.asv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

13.web: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons, forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name, forever.
13.asv: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons, for ever, to burn incense before Jehovah, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, for ever.

14.web: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
14.asv: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

15.web: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
15.asv: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

16.web: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
16.asv: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

17.web: The sons of Eliezer were: Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
17.asv: And the sons of Eliezer were: Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

18.web: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
18.asv: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

19.web: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
19.asv: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

20.web: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
20.asv: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

21.web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
21.asv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

22.web: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only: and their brothers the sons of Kish took them as wives.
22.asv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only: and their brethren the sons of Kish took themto wife.

23.web: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
23.asv: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

24.web: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
24.asv: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’housesof those of them that were counted, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the house of Jehovah, from twenty years old and upward.

25.web: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
25.asv: For David said, Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath given rest unto his people; and he dwelleth in Jerusalem for ever:

26.web: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
26.asv: and also the Levites shall no more have need to carry the tabernacle and all the vessels of it for the service thereof.

27.web: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were numbered, from twenty years old and upward.
27.asv: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were numbered, from twenty years old and upward.

28.web: For their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house, in the courts, and in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;
28.asv: For their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of Jehovah, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of the house of God;

29.web: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all kinds of measure and size;
29.asv: for the showbread also, and for the fine flour for a meal-offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all manner of measure and size;

30.web: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;
30.asv: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Jehovah, and likewise at even;

31.web: and to offer all burnt offerings to Yahweh, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Yahweh;
31.asv: and to offer all burnt-offerings unto Jehovah, on the sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Jehovah;

32.web: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, and the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers, for the service of Yahweh’s house.
32.asv: and that they should keep the charge of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, for the service of the house of Jehovah.
